description: Aider-polyglot style (Java): enumerate all shortest word ladders between two words from a stub and an instructions file - every shortest ladder (not one), lexicographic ordering of the ladders, start word allowed outside the dictionary, start equal to end, unreachable and missing-end cases, different lengths and case sensitivity, and dictionaries of thousands of words with over a hundred answers (breadth-first layers with parent lists rather than path enumeration). A protected run_tests.py compiles with javac and runs the plain-Java test runner; the post-turn verifier gives a failing first attempt a repair round, like aider's second try.
